overview_description.description:
UVA (Pronounced U.V.A.) is an app-based e-Hailing service that’s as solid as a rock. It’s where you know what the pricing will be for your journey – because it doesn’t mysteriously change every trip. Where there’s no ‘surge charge’ when things start to get busy.

UVA isn’t just another e-Hailing company. It’s how things should be done. Will be done. Delivered by a network who are trusted by us, and where standards are controlled and cared for by us – so you know every ride will be as good as the one before. Welcome to UVA.
